verdict.rationale: Deel publishes only one provider-side timeline: a visa or eligibility assessment delivered within 48 hours. Its other time commitment is a 24-hour case-manager response time. Neither tells a founder how long Deel takes to prepare the application or how long the government takes to process it, so this is glancing support. Missing for 10: published application/petition preparation time, government processing-time estimates per visa type (e.g. USCIS for O-1A/EB-2 NIW), and end-to-end timeline expectations.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on

citations.quote: Quickly assess visa options with results delivered within 48 hours, including a cost breakdown and document requirements.
Pre-hire eligibility checks: Get eligibility confirmation for your employee within 48 hours.
Dedicated case manager and attorneys (responses within 24 hours)
